instruction_ref: CEO: 新規とRecoveryを別実装にするな。投入順序を変更し、FMT差分は変換Gateで吸収する。Recoveryは共通Pipelineへのファストパス。作り直せ。
instruction: Use the existing Growth Runtime and article Job for both new and historical articles. Prioritize existing due recovery work; adapt legacy Planning inputs to the shared Product role rather than using a second Product research/QA. Replace the special launch with the single approved launcher, sharing Git synchronization, while keeping new-topic admission stopped by default.
implementer: sellemy-ops direct Python staging, no Codex
preserved_rules: No new Runtime, Queue, quality threshold or business ledger; same existing single article Job, product QA, writer, reviewer, designer, publish and CEO Gate
No new topic until explicit CEO authorization: launcher SELLEMY_NEW_TOPICS_ENABLED defaults to 0 and plist pins 0
Existing published slug/category/commit/evidence/approval and article file are retained until the shared Product role passes acceptance
Existing common scheduler/admission, role I/O and backoff remain responsible for execution and retries
Historical PLANNING_HOLD work is admitted only once under the new input adapter revision, never infinitely retried
